method: For each modeled strategy/benchmark, shares held before the ex-date opening are prior-date buys minus prior-date sells. Same-day buys are not eligible; same-day sales preserve eligibility. Fill timestamps are session-close labels, so comparison uses session dates. Fractional-reference quantity is allocated_cash / first_next_open from feasibility output.
limits: Yahoo recorded dividend events are provider metadata, not confirmed issuer payment records.
Gross entitlement excludes withholding, FX, payment timing and reinvestment; it is an upper bound on added net dividend return, not cash proven paid by evaluation end.
Ex-date on the final evaluation day may leave an unpaid receivable at the endpoint.
No strategy is rerun with dividend cash, so the addition is accounting sensitivity at the recorded path, not a counterfactual performance result.
CMCSA pre-spinoff provider dividends are adjusted; pre-2026-01-06 CMCSA periods are excluded and these adjusted events do not enter comparisons.
